key_findings: Chemogenetic activation of spinal Tacr1 (or Tac1) neurons evokes somatotopic fictive pain and suppresses chloroquine itch; these neurons project to Tacr1+ neurons in the superior lateral PBN.

PBN-SL Tacr1 neurons respond to sustained but not acute noxious stimuli; activating them heightens nocifensive behavior and suppresses itch, while silencing them nearly abolishes responses to sustained pain.
